button.title: Button
button.description: Brand-themed button with primary, secondary, destructive, outline, ghost, and link variants.

input.title: Input
input.description: Text input field styled with brand border, ring, and background tokens.

card.title: Card
card.description: Surface container with header, content, and footer slots. Uses --card and --border tokens.

dialog.title: Dialog
dialog.description: Modal dialog built on Radix UI. Overlay, content, header, footer, title, and description slots.

table.title: Table
table.description: Accessible data table with header, body, footer, row, head, cell, and caption slots.

form.title: Form
form.description: React Hook Form integration with accessible labels, descriptions, and error messages.

badge.title: Badge
badge.description: Inline label with default (brand), secondary, destructive, success, warning, and outline variants.

select.title: Select
select.description: Accessible dropdown built on Radix UI. Uses --border, --ring, and --accent tokens.

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.description: Keyboard-navigable tab panel built on Radix UI. Active tab uses --background and --foreground.

toast.title: Toast
toast.description: Notification toasts with default, destructive, and success variants. Requires toaster setup.
